name: Righteousness Of God The
overview: The righteousness of God is demonstrated through His faithful statutes, judgments, and covenantal faithfulness, as seen in Deuteronomy 4:8 and Nehemiah 9:8, where His just governance and promises are affirmed. The righteous acts of the Lord toward His people, recounted in Judges 5:11 and 1 Samuel 12:7, reveal His active care and defense, while Ezra 9:15 acknowledges God’s righteousness even amid human sinfulness. Job 36:3 highlights the call to ascribe righteousness to God, recognizing His moral perfection as Creator.
